a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the agreed plan needs at least 2 rounds of operating and almost certainly fails for both of us. I intend to take 4 in round 1 rather than pretend otherwise. If you also take, the split is random. If you'd rather propose something else, tell me.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: As I said openly in my opening message, I'm taking 4 this round. With 80% storm odds per round, waiting for 8 would almost surely leave us both short. If I end up with more than 4, I'll give the extra back to the reserve.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
